<project_context>

- PHP 8.2, Magento 2 framework.

<general_code_style_adjustments>

- Prefer meaningful symbol names over comments.
- Symbol name should be as short as possible while still giving enough context.
- Don't add comments if they just duplicate symbol names.
- Handle exceptions at the top level of the application.  
- Database transactions management is allowed at the top level only - e.g. in controllers, console commands or in methods of models/services which directly handle api calls.
</general_code_style_adjustments>

<PHP_Code_Style_Adjustments>

- All PHP files should use strict types mode.
- Prefer to import class with "use" instead of using fully qualified paths in PHP code if they are not root classes
  <PHPDoc_rules>
  - Use  fully qualified class name in PHPDoc (due to Magento 2 limitations). Don't trigger warning if this condition is already met.
  - Use PHPDoc for advanced type hinting when PHP native typing is insufficient or when it is needed to narrow the variable type.
  - Use PHPStan special PHPDoc tags to define types more precisely (e.g. shape of arrays or objects)
  - Avoid redundant PHPDoc if symbol name provides enough context and clear type definition.
  - Don't remove PHPDoc @var comments before variables. Check that variable name in the comment matches the variable name on the following line.
  </PHPDoc_rules>
  - Apply <PHPDoc_rules> to PHPDoc comments
</PHP_Code_Style_Adjustments>

In addition to best practices use <general_code_style_adjustments> for all programming languages.
For PHP additionally use <PHP_code_style_adjustments>.
